newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda to form Vietnam motorbike parts unit.
newsitem.headline: Honda to form Vietnam motorbike parts unit.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd said on Wednesday it had agreed to form a joint venture to produce motorcycle parts in Vietnam.
The new company, Goshi-Thang Long Auto Parts Co Ltd, will be capitalised at $5.7 million.

It will be owned 35 percent by Goshi Giken Co Ltd, Honda's affiliated motorcycle parts maker, 30 percent by Thang Long Metal Wares Co, a Vietnam plating and plate working firm, 25 percent by Asian Honda Co, Honda's Thai unit, and 10 percent by Honda Trading Corp, Honda's trading arm.
Honda owns 42.58 percent of Goshi Giken.
The joint venture in a suburb of Hanoi will create 200 jobs initially, a Honda spokesman said.
The partners will invest $13.78 million into the venture and hope to start producing mufflers, shift pedals and brake pedals by the end of 1997.

The products will be supplied to Honda Vietnam Co Ltd which is expected to begin operations by the end of 1997, with a planned annual output of 200,000 motorcycles. The joint venture hopes to receive Vietnam government approval by the end of the year, the spokesman said.
